name: Detailed Instruction Cancellation Status 16
definition: Status applying to individual cancellation instructions of a meeting instruction cancellation request message.

SingleInstructionCancellationIdentificat.name: Single Instruction Cancellation Identification
SingleInstructionCancellationIdentificat.definition: Identification of the specific individual instruction cancellation request from the original meeting instruction cancellation request message identified in InstructionType/ InstructionCancellationIdentification, for which the status is provided.

SubAccountIdentification.name: Sub Account Identification
SubAccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the subaccount within the safekeeping account.

InstructionCancellationStatus.name: Instruction Cancellation Status
InstructionCancellationStatus.definition: Status of an individual meeting instruction cancellation request.

SubAccount1Rule.definition: If SubAccountIdentification is present, then AccountIdentification must be present.
